purpose: Define privacy/security data categories as explicit metadata/evidence tied to exact fields/resources and source policy rather than guessed from field names.

owns: Data Category and Privacy Classification semantics

topics.name: Data Category and Privacy Classification
topics.purpose: Define privacy/security data categories as explicit metadata/evidence tied to exact fields/resources and source policy rather than guessed from field names.

semantics.category_rule: Each data category/classification has explicit identity.
semantics.inherit_rule: Derived/joined data classification follows explicit propagation rules.
semantics.name_rule: Field name alone never determines classification.
semantics.authority_rule: Classification is governance metadata, not authorization.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.

hard_gates.condition: email field automatically classified solely by name

references.purpose: Catalog may project source classification metadata.
